verdict.rationale: The firm's strategic transactions & licensing page lists 'Open source software compliance' and 'Commercializing open source software and related business models' as named types of strategic counsel. That page is backed by the firm's claim of the largest licensing-focused team for emerging companies, so the core of the story is a documented, named capability. Missing for 10: any explicit mention of drafting OSS usage policies for product companies, any detail on the scope or depth of the compliance work (e.g., audits, license-conflict analysis), and independent or client corroboration.
